# SI033 — unbounded-prompt-interpolation

Raw fetched or model text must not be interpolated without a cap.

## Why

Even fenced text can exceed the model context or hide instructions after a truncation boundary.

## Bad

```python
f"<evidence>{fetched_page}</evidence>"
```

## Good

```python
f"<evidence>{_render_evidence(items)}</evidence>"
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI033 -- reason
```

- AGENTS.md §12.6, §12.7
